easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Dormant Volcano.
When Dormant Volcano enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Dormant Volcano.
Resolve the Dormant Volcano trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Dormant Volcano from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
